title: Present value
note: One beat = one thing said. `show` is what fills the screen while it is said: `you` (camera) or `anim`. `in` is the transition INTO the beat. Every `on` is a word in that beat's `say` — the element lands when that word is spoken. Edit `say`, re-run the voice step, and the whole edit re-times itself.

beats.say: A hundred kwacha next year is not worth a hundred kwacha today. Here is the maths.
Present value equals future value, divided by one plus r, to the power of n. Where r is the rate per year, and n is the number of years.
Say your bank pays ten percent a year.
Then a hundred kwacha, one year out, is a hundred over one point one. Ninety kwacha, ninety one.
Two years out, eighty two sixty four. Three years, seventy five thirteen.
The further away the money, the less it is worth today. That is discounting.
Net present value. Bond prices. Loan repayments.
All of it runs on this one line.
